items.question: Which additional female figures are included among those who know through devotion on earth?
premises: The preceding verses request identification of those who know through devotion on earth.
Female figures named by bird or animal forms are being enumerated as such knowers.
This verse adds further named female figures to that ongoing enumeration.
items.inference: The owl-woman, peacock-woman, sarari-woman, and guli-woman are included among the female knowers named in this series.
uncertainties: The precise identity or tradition-specific significance of sararī and gūlī is not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: The owl-woman, or indeed the peacock-woman, or the sarari-woman, or likewise the guli-woman.
